items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: But we alternated with them on the bandstand, see. And we had some great, great times there.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, yeah! He was a trip. And he was a great guy. But we alternated with them on the bandstand, see. And we had some great, great times there.
And a little later on, they did some alterations in the place and moved the bandstand on the other side of the wall.
